target.title: fix(qa): OTEL smoke produces evidence for absolute artifact roots
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the deterministic QA OTEL smoke produced no telemetry evidence when QA Lab supplied its artifact directory as an absolute path. The nested QA CLI rejected that path because `--output-dir` must be repo-relative, as observed in QA Smoke run 28693549515 artifact `qa-smoke-profile-28693549515-1`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OTEL producer continues to own and read its absolute host artifact path, but converts that path to a repo-relative value only at the nested `openclaw qa suite` argument boundary. The existing QA CLI containment validation remains authoritative, including the repository-root `.` boundary.

## User Impact

QA Smoke can complete the deterministic OTEL scenario and publish trace, metric, and log evidence when the harness uses an absolute artifact root.

## Evidence

- Before: running the producer from current `origin/main` with an absolute in-repo `--output-dir` exited with `--output-dir must be a relative path inside the repo root`, followed by zero trace, metric, and log requests.
- After: the same real smoke command passed with 17 spans, 39 metrics, 18 OTLP log records, and 18 stdout log records while the summary retained the absolute producer output path.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/qa-otel-smoke.e2e.test.ts` — 41 tests passed.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `corepack pnpm check:changed` — passed on `tbx_01kwnm2gw0ys9nnccqkk95jm1s` (Actions run 28694077835).
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean after accepting and fixing the repo-root `.` boundary finding.
